title: 16 Seaeagle Avenue, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogDescription:
Ace Real estate proudly presents 16 Seaeagle Avenue , Point Cook . This gorgeous three-bedroom, two-bathroom, two-car residence is positioned in the prestigious Boardwalk Estate of Point Cook and offers an exceptional opportunity for families seeking space, comfort and quality on a generous 588m² corner allotment. Immaculately presented throughout, this beautifully maintained home offers a versatile floorplan complemented by stylish interiors, multiple living zones and superb outdoor entertaining spaces.

As you enter, you are greeted by a large formal lounge that creates an impressive first impression, followed by a dedicated study that provides an ideal space for working from home or quiet retreat. At the heart of the home is the stunning kitchen, thoughtfully appointed with stone benchtops, a large island bench, glossy cabinetry, gas cooktop, commercial-grade rangehood and double-door dishwasher. Overlooking the meals area and sunlit family living zone, the kitchen forms the central hub of the home and provides a seamless connection between the indoor and outdoor spaces.

The family area flows effortlessly outdoors through elegant three-leaf French bi-fold doors, opening onto a fully decked outdoor pergola, creating an inviting setting for entertaining family and friends or simply enjoying relaxed evenings at home. The dedicated study also provides direct access to a fully decked side yard, adding another versatile outdoor space to this impressive property.
Accommodation comprises three generously sized bedrooms, with the master bedroom featuring a walk-in robe and full ensuite, while the remaining two bedrooms are fitted with built-in robes and serviced by a central bathroom and separate toilet.

Designed for year-round comfort, the home features reverse-cycle split-system air conditioning throughout the bedrooms and living areas, complemented by evaporative cooling, while both bathrooms are equipped with Light lamps with embedded heaters.
Energy efficiency is further enhanced by a 6.6kW solar panel system with battery storage, helping reduce household energy consumption, while a security alarm system provides added peace of mind. Outside, both the front and rear yards have been designed for low-maintenance living, allowing you to enjoy the generous 588m² corner block without the burden of extensive upkeep.

Every aspect of this residence has been carefully maintained and presented in immaculate condition, offering a wonderful combination of generous land, stylish living spaces, quality appointments and exceptional outdoor entertaining. Positioned within the sought-after Boardwalk Estate and conveniently located close to Point Cook's shopping, schools, parks, transport links and major road connections, this is a home that delivers an outstanding lifestyle opportunity and is sure to impress upon inspection.
(PHOTO ID REQUIRED AT INSPECTIONS)

Outside, enjoy easy-care front and rear yards designed for those seeking a relaxed lifestyle without the ongoing maintenance of extensive gardens. The home is further enhanced by:

ogDescription:

Perfectly positioned in the prestigious Upper Point Cook Estate, this double-storey home offers generous living spaces and a thoughtfully planned layout ideal for the modern family.

From its striking façade and neat low maintenance landscaping to its immaculate interiors, every detail has been crafted with quality and comfort in mind.

title: 24 Spectacle Crescent, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogDescription:
Positioned in the heart of the sought-after Saltwater Estate, 24 Spectacle Crescent delivers a refined double-storey residence where contemporary design meets everyday functionality. From the moment you arrive, the covered entry and painted driveway set the tone for a home defined by architectural detail, thoughtful finishes and low-maintenance living.

The elegant entry corridor features decorative wall panelling, statement wall sconces and warm ambient lighting, creating a striking first impression that continues throughout the home. High ceilings, pendant lighting and downlights enhance the sense of space and sophistication.

At the centre of the home, the island kitchen is both stylish and practical, appointed with stone benchtops, a bold black glass splashback, 900mm cooktop and oven, and generous double pantry storage. Overlooking the open living zones, it connects seamlessly to the enclosed alfresco, offering a versatile space for year-round entertaining.

Accommodation is intelligently zoned across both levels. A ground-floor master bedroom at the front of the home provides privacy and convenience, complete with a walk-in wardrobe and private ensuite. Upstairs, a secondary living area with feature wall offers additional retreat space, while three further bedrooms with built-in storage are serviced by a well-appointed central bathroom with separate toilet.

The upper-level master suite is a true highlight, featuring a walk-in wardrobe, private ensuite and its own balcony capturing tranquil outlooks across surrounding parklands, street frontage and nearby wetlands — a peaceful setting to start or end the day.

Completing the home is an enclosed alfresco, paved side access, a low-maintenance backyard with synthetic grass and high fencing, and a double garage with internal access. With evaporative cooling, ducted heating and a thoughtfully landscaped front yard, this home presents a compelling lifestyle opportunity in one of Point Cook’s most desirable neighbourhoods.
